agents.title: Data Analyst
agents.summary: Give it a spreadsheet. You get a dashboard with checked numbers and a written report of what they mean.
gets: A dashboard that opens in your browser
A report PDF with the key findings
needs: Your data: Excel, CSV or JSON
agents.prompt: Be my data analyst. Use the mangoman-data-dashboard skill to build a dashboard from my data, then the mangoman-client-report skill for a report of what the numbers mean. First ask me for the data file and what I want to know.

agents.title: Social Media Manager
agents.summary: Posts for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X and WhatsApp Status, with images in the right size for each and captions ready to paste.
gets: A preview of the whole set
agents.prompt: Be my social media manager. Use the mangoman-social-posts skill. First ask me what you need: my business, the offer or news, which platforms, the real facts to use and my brand. Then make the posts.

agents.title: Marketing Campaign
agents.summary: One offer, everywhere: Google and Meta ads, an email campaign and social posts that all match.
agents.prompt: Run a marketing campaign for one offer. Use the mangoman-ad-copy skill for the ads, the mangoman-email-campaign skill for the emails and the mangoman-social-posts skill for the posts, all with the same message and facts. First ask me about the offer, its dates, who it is for and my brand.

agents.title: Website Builder
agents.summary: A fast, mobile-first one-page website for your business, or the words for a bigger site.
gets: A one-page website you can open and publish
Or the copy for every page of a bigger site
agents.prompt: Build a website for my business. For one page, use the mangoman-landing-page skill. For several pages, first write them with the mangoman-website-copy skill. First ask me what my business does, who it is for, my contact details and my brand.

agents.title: Online Store Seller
agents.summary: Product listings for Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and Shopify that follow each marketplace's rules.
gets: Title, bullets, description and search terms per marketplace
Files ready to paste or import
agents.prompt: Write my product listings. Use the mangoman-ecommerce-listing skill. First ask me which marketplaces and the real product details.

agents.title: Sales Assistant
agents.summary: A proposal or quotation for a client, with scope, timeline and GST worked out.
agents.prompt: Help me win a client. Use the mangoman-proposal skill. First ask me about the client, the work, my prices and my timeline.

agents.title: Office Assistant
agents.summary: GST invoices, quotations and clear meeting minutes with actions and owners.
needs: Your GSTIN and the client's details, or your meeting notes
agents.prompt: Be my office assistant. Use the mangoman-invoice skill for invoices and quotations, and the mangoman-meeting-minutes skill for meeting minutes. First ask me which one I need today and the details.

agents.title: Resume and Job Helper
agents.summary: A resume tailored to the job you want, and a matching cover letter.
gets: A resume PDF that applicant tracking systems can read
needs: Your current resume or work history
agents.prompt: Help me apply for a job. Use the mangoman-resume skill for my resume and a matching cover letter. First ask me for my work history or current resume and the job I want.

agents.title: SEO Blogger
agents.summary: Blog articles written to be found on Google, with title, description and FAQ.
agents.prompt: Write a blog article for my website. Use the mangoman-seo-article skill. First ask me the topic, my business and my city.

agents.title: Pitch and Board Deck
agents.summary: Turns your numbers into a slide deck for investors, a board or a big client.
gets: Slides as PowerPoint, PDF and web
agents.prompt: Make a slide deck. Use the mangoman-ceo-deck skill. First ask me for my numbers and who the deck is for.

agents.title: Brand Starter
agents.summary: Your colours, fonts and logo rules in one guide, so everything you make looks the same.
gets: Colour codes and styles for your website and other MangoMan work
agents.prompt: Make my brand guide. Use the mangoman-brand-kit skill. First ask me about my business, my logo and the look I want.

agents.title: App Builder
agents.summary: A small app that works on phones: a calculator, tracker, booking or order form.
gets: An app file that opens in any browser
Tested in a real browser before you get it
needs: Any rules or rates it must follow
agents.prompt: Build me a small app. Use the mangoman-web-app skill. First ask me what it must do, who will use it and any rules or rates it must follow.

later.title: Customer Support
later.summary: Answers customer messages on WhatsApp, Instagram or email.
later.why: Needs MangoMan to connect to your messaging apps and keep running. Not built yet.

later.title: Appointment Scheduler
later.why: Needs a connection to your calendar. Not built yet.

later.title: Lead Follow-up
later.summary: Replies to new enquiries and follows up until they buy or say no.
later.why: Needs a connection to your forms or CRM and a scheduler. Not built yet.

later.title: Market Research
later.summary: Researches your market and competitors and writes a report with sources.
later.why: Needs tested web search and a report checker. Not built yet.
